subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should the old `steipete/bird` slug be republished or aliased to Birdclaw, left hidden, or surfaced as a deprecated/unavailable skill?
rationale: Current main has generic install and missing-skill behavior but no Bird payload, and changing old-slug semantics requires owner/admin intent rather than source inference.

options.title: Verify and update metadata
options.body: Confirm the canonical upstream with the owner, then republish or alias `steipete/bird` only if Birdclaw is the intended successor.

options.title: Keep old slug unavailable
options.body: If the original project was intentionally removed, leave the public API hidden or mark the skill deprecated/unavailable with clear user-facing status.

options.title: Build a broken-skill workflow
options.body: If this class of failure is recurring, add a source-backed unavailable-state or broken-install workflow before changing individual records.

recommendation.title: Verify and update metadata
recommendation.body: Confirm the canonical upstream with the owner, then republish or alias `steipete/bird` only if Birdclaw is the intended successor.
